responsibility: This source file implements the NDS32 RTL pass that groups instruction sequences for linker relaxation by inserting relax-hint markers with unique group ids. It scans define-use chains and dominator relationships to recognize symbolic address materialization, PIC/TLS access patterns, and certain floating load/store address sequences that can be shrunk or transformed by the linker, making it the backend’s dedicated relaxation-preparation pass rather than the code that emits the base instruction forms themselves.
